title: Wrap scope keys for devices
responsibility: Wrap scope keys for one device with HPKE and unwrap them only when the verified device chain grants the scope and records a matching commitment.

inputs.name: sealedGrantInfo.grant
inputs.description: Grant metadata to bind to encryption and decryption.

inputs.name: sealedGrant.account
inputs.description: Account identifier to bind to the grant.

inputs.name: sealedGrant.raw
inputs.description: Scope identifier, epoch, and raw key bytes to wrap.

inputs.name: sealedGrant.device
inputs.description: Recipient device identifier and public key-agreement key.

inputs.name: openSealedGrant.grant
inputs.description: Encrypted grant to validate and unwrap.

inputs.name: openSealedGrant.self
inputs.description: Receiving device identity and private key-agreement key.

inputs.name: openSealedGrant.chain
inputs.description: Verified chain state supplying the account, scope grant, and key commitment.

outputs.name: sealedGrantInfo
outputs.description: Bytes that bind the grant metadata to the encrypted keys.

outputs.name: sealedGrant
outputs.description: Wrapped scope keys and the metadata required to identify their recipient and epoch.

outputs.name: openSealedGrant
outputs.description: Imported scope keys whose commitment matches the verified chain.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The recipient, scope, epoch, authentication, key size, or commitment fails validation.
